tools.description: Discover UniFi Site Manager tools (hosts, sites and devices across consoles, ISP metrics, and SD-WAN status from UniFi Site Manager) through the compact tool index. The catalog is manifest-backed in lazy mode; in meta-only mode it starts with registered meta-tools and expands after domain modules execute. Standard MCP clients should prefer tools/list when it exposes the needed tools.
tools.name: sitemanager_tool_index

category.description: Filter to one category. Valid values are returned in the 'categories' field of every response.

include_schemas.description: Include full input/output schemas per tool. Defaults to false — set true with a name, category or search filter to get parameter details for specific tools.

name.description: Exact, case-sensitive tool name. Cannot be combined with category or search. Unknown names return an empty index.

search.description: Case-insensitive token search over tool names and descriptions. Ignores common words and one-character terms; multi-word queries require at least half of usable terms (minimum two). Terms of four or more characters also match token prefixes. Results are ranked by exact phrase and name matches, with at most 20 returned. An empty string applies no filter; a non-empty query with no usable terms returns no tools.

categories.description: All available category names (use as values for the category filter)

filtered.description: True when name, category or search filter was applied

tools.description: Matching tools with name and description (plus schemas if include_schemas)

tools.title: UniFi Site Manager Tool Index
